title: 把脚点找回来
description: 成人从低墙缓慢向下找大脚点，手脚仍保持稳定支撑。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult carefully downclimbs a low vertical wall, one shoe moving toward a large foothold just above the mat while the other foot and both hands remain secure. The eyes follow the descending foot and the torso stays close. Capture a controlled downward step rather than a drop, with no airborne body. The wall is sparse and calm, and the floor space beneath the figure is clear of bags and other people. Use quilted textile illustration with stitched fabric shapes, readable adult anatomy, felt-like mat surfaces, and a calm blue and sand palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
